When last year's outcome belongs on the right-hand side, the fixed-effects
estimator of the [core chapter](../05-core/index.qmd) is biased, and the
bias shrinks only as the number of periods grows. This chapter shows the
bias, the instruments that remove it, and the diagnostics that say whether
they did. The plan is `.docs/plans/0010-dynamic-chapter.md`.
